YOUR WINE COMPANION

This is not an app.
It’s your wine companion.

Intimacy is legacy.

The problem
350bottles in your cellar

So which one tonight?

Our app tells you what to drink. Not what to buy.

The idea

A wine companion that knows every bottle you own.

It knows what you ownPhotographed, researched, counted.
It asks what you eatAt home, or at a restaurant.
It suggests what to openFrom your cellar first.
It remembers your tasteFrom your likes and wishlist.
